sdg_explanation: Python can support automation and research tooling, connecting to technological upgrading (8.2) and research capability (9.5) when used for those purposes.
Java can support maintainable business applications and process automation, contributing to technological upgrading under target 8.2 when responsibly deployed.
JavaScript can make web-based information and services usable through browsers, supporting ICT access under target 9.c when access barriers are addressed.
Accessible HTML and CSS can reduce barriers to digital information (9.c) and participation for people with different abilities (10.2); accessibility must be designed and tested.
SQL supports reliable retrieval of research and operational data, which can enable evidence-based innovation under target 9.5; data quality and governance remain necessary.
Git supports traceable collaboration and reproducible research software, which can strengthen research and innovation capability under target 9.5.
Algorithms and data structures support efficient research and engineering software, contributing to scientific and technological capability under target 9.5.
Software testing can improve the reliability of digital systems used in infrastructure, supporting resilience under target 9.1 when applied to relevant services.
API development can connect digital services and information systems, supporting useful ICT access under target 9.c when interfaces are secure and accessible.
User-centred and accessible interface design can reduce participation barriers for diverse users, supporting inclusion under target 10.2 when validated with those users.
Computer graphics can communicate technical concepts in learning materials (4.4) and visualise scientific models for research (9.5), depending on the project.
3D modelling can support engineering prototypes and simulation, contributing to research and innovation capability under target 9.5 in relevant projects.
Data analysis can support scientific investigation (9.5) and scrutiny of institutional performance (16.6), provided the data is appropriate and conclusions are accountable.
Statistics supports uncertainty-aware scientific analysis and evaluation, contributing to stronger research capability under target 9.5.
Clear and accessible data visualisation can help people scrutinise institutional performance, supporting transparency under target 16.6 when the underlying data is sound.
Machine learning can support research and technological experimentation under target 9.5; responsible evaluation is required and social benefit is not automatic.
Database design can improve the integrity and reliability of information systems supporting infrastructure, linking to resilience under target 9.1.
Computer networking can support access to ICT services under target 9.c; affordability and equitable deployment determine whether access actually improves.
Linux administration can help maintain dependable computing services used by infrastructure and research, linking to targets 9.1 and 9.5.
Cloud computing can support scalable digital services and research infrastructure under targets 9.1 and 9.5 when resilience and access are explicitly addressed.
Network security can protect continuity of digital infrastructure (9.1) and safeguard institutional information systems (16.6); controls must be appropriate and reviewed.
Security risk assessment can make institutional technology decisions more accountable through documented risks and controls, supporting target 16.6.
